violation_type.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.211(b))
violation_type.short_title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual liability insurance requirement.
